svg.title: Separate Azure rights from local authentication
svg.desc: One shared Microsoft Entra ID and Azure RBAC boundary authorizes Azure operations, not local logon. Choose exactly one local authentication model: AD DS or local identity with a dedicated Key Vault. Both choices lead to operations and recovery. Key Vault is not presented as an interactive local-logon service.

metadata.data-provenance: Supplied Azure icon SVG artwork, embedded inline
metadata.data-asset-policy: Original artwork; namespaced IDs; no external assets

text.tspan: Separate Azure rights from local authentication
Reading order: 1 shared Azure boundary, then choose 2A or 2B, then 3 operations.
Role assignments authorize Azure resource operations.
They do not grant local logon.
Retain lifecycle access; validate DNS/time and backup.
Workload identity remains a separate decision.
Local identity: PowerShell / Azure portal / Azure Monitor supported;
